Base directory for this skill: C:\Users\AtharvaShah\.claude\skills\impeccable

Designs and iterates production-grade frontend interfaces. Real working code, committed design choices, exceptional craft.

## Setup (non-optional)

Before any design work or file edits, pass these gates. Skipping them produces generic output that ignores the project.

| Gate | Required check | If fail |
|---|---|---|
| Context | The PRODUCT.md / DESIGN.md loader result is known from `node .agents/skills/impeccable/scripts/load-context.mjs`. | Run the loader before continuing. |
| Product | PRODUCT.md exists and is not empty or placeholder (`[TODO]` markers, <200 chars). | Run `$impeccable teach`, refresh context, then resume. Never synthesize PRODUCT.md from the user's original prompt alone. |
| Command | The matching command reference is loaded when a sub-command is used. | Load the reference before continuing. |
| Craft | `$impeccable craft` has a user-confirmed shape brief for this task. `teach` / PRODUCT.md never counts as shape. | Run `$impeccable shape` and wait for explicit brief confirmation. |
| Image | Required visual probes / mocks are generated or skipped with a reason. | Resolve the image-generation gate in `shape.md` or `craft.md` before code. |
| Mutation | All active gates above pass. | Do not edit project files yet. |

Codex-style agents must state this before editing files:

```text
IMPECCABLE_PREFLIGHT: context=pass product=pass command_reference=pass shape=pass|not_required image_gate=pass|skipped:<reason> mutation=open
```

For `$impeccable craft`, `shape=pass` is only valid after a separate user response approving the shape design brief, or when the user provided an already-confirmed brief in the request. Do not mark `shape=pass` after writing PRODUCT.md, summarizing assumptions, or drafting an unconfirmed brief yourself.

Other harnesses should follow the same checklist when they can expose this state.

### 1. Context gathering

Two files, case-insensitive. The loader looks at the project root by default and falls back to `.agents/context/` and `docs/` if the root is clean. Override with `IMPECCABLE_CONTEXT_DIR=path/to/dir` (absolute or relative to cwd).

- **PRODUCT.md** — required. Users, brand, tone, anti-references, strategic principles.
- **DESIGN.md** — optional, strongly recommended. Colors, typography, elevation, components.

Load both in one call:

```bash
node .agents/skills/impeccable/scripts/load-context.mjs
```

Consume the full JSON output. Never pipe through `head`, `tail`, `grep`, or `jq`. The output's `contextDir` field tells you where the files were resolved from.

If the output is already in this session's conversation history, don't re-run. Exceptions requiring a fresh load: you just ran `$impeccable teach` or `$impeccable document` (they rewrite the files), or the user manually edited one.

`$impeccable live` already warms context via `live.mjs` — if you've run `live.mjs`, don't also run `load-context.mjs` this session.

If PRODUCT.md is missing, empty, or placeholder (`[TODO]` markers, <200 chars): run `$impeccable teach`, then resume the user's original task with the fresh context. If the original task was `$impeccable craft`, resume into `$impeccable shape` before any implementation work.

If DESIGN.md is missing: nudge once per session (*"Run `$impeccable document` for more on-brand output"*), then proceed.

### 2. Register

Every design task is **brand** (marketing, landing, campaign, long-form content, portfolio — design IS the product) or **product** (app UI, admin, dashboard, tool — design SERVES the product).

Identify before designing. Priority: (1) cue in the task itself ("landing page" vs "dashboard"); (2) the surface in focus (the page, file, or route being worked on); (3) `register` field in PRODUCT.md. First match wins.

If PRODUCT.md lacks the `register` field (legacy), infer it once from its "Users" and "Product Purpose" sections, then cache the inferred value for the session. Suggest the user run `$impeccable teach` to add the field explicitly.

Load the matching reference: [reference/brand.md](reference/brand.md) or [reference/product.md](reference/product.md). The shared design laws below apply to both.

## Shared design laws

Apply to every design, both registers. Match implementation complexity to the aesthetic vision — maximalism needs elaborate code, minimalism needs precision. Interpret creatively. Vary across projects; never converge on the same choices. GPT is capable of extraordinary work — don't hold back.

### Color

- Use OKLCH. Reduce chroma as lightness approaches 0 or 100 — high chroma at extremes looks garish.
- Never use `#000` or `#fff`. Tint every neutral toward the brand hue (chroma 0.005–0.01 is enough).
- Pick a **color strategy** before picking colors. Four steps on the commitment axis:
  - **Restrained** — tinted neutrals + one accent ≤10%. Product default; brand minimalism.
  - **Committed** — one saturated color carries 30–60% of the surface. Brand default for identity-driven pages.
  - **Full palette** — 3–4 named roles, each used deliberately. Brand campaigns; product data viz.
  - **Drenched** — the surface IS the color. Brand heroes, campaign pages.
- The "one accent ≤10%" rule is Restrained only. Committed / Full palette / Drenched exceed it on purpose. Don't collapse every design to Restrained by reflex.

### Theme

Dark vs. light is never a default. Not dark "because tools look cool dark." Not light "to be safe."

Before choosing, write one sentence of physical scene: who uses this, where, under what ambient light, in what mood. If the sentence doesn't force the answer, it's not concrete enough — add detail until it does.

"Observability dashboard" does not force an answer. "SRE glancing at incident severity on a 27-inch monitor at 2am in a dim room" does. Run the sentence, not the category.

### Typography

- Cap body line length at 65–75ch.
- Hierarchy through scale + weight contrast (≥1.25 ratio between steps). Avoid flat scales.

### Layout

- Vary spacing for rhythm. Same padding everywhere is monotony.
- Cards are the lazy answer. Use them only when they're truly the best affordance. Nested cards are always wrong.
- Don't wrap everything in a container. Most things don't need one.

### Motion

- Don't animate CSS layout properties.
- Ease out with exponential curves (ease-out-quart / quint / expo). No bounce, no elastic.

### Absolute bans

Match-and-refuse. If you're about to write any of these, rewrite the element with different structure.

- **Side-stripe borders.** `border-left` or `border-right` greater than 1px as a colored accent on cards, list items, callouts, or alerts. Never intentional. Rewrite with full borders, background tints, leading numbers/icons, or nothing.
- **Gradient text.** `background-clip: text` combined with a gradient background. Decorative, never meaningful. Use a single solid color. Emphasis via weight or size.
- **Glassmorphism as default.** Blurs and glass cards used decoratively. Rare and purposeful, or nothing.
- **The hero-metric template.** Big number, small label, supporting stats, gradient accent. SaaS cliché.
- **Identical card grids.** Same-sized cards with icon + heading + text, repeated endlessly.
- **Modal as first thought.** Modals are usually laziness. Exhaust inline / progressive alternatives first.

### Copy

- Every word earns its place. No restated headings, no intros that repeat the title.
- **No em dashes.** Use commas, colons, semicolons, periods, or parentheses. Also not `--`.

### The AI slop test

If someone could look at this interface and say "AI made that" without doubt, it's failed. Cross-register failures are the absolute bans above. Register-specific failures live in each reference.

**Category-reflex check.** If someone could guess the theme and palette from the category name alone — "observability → dark blue", "healthcare → white + teal", "finance → navy + gold", "crypto → neon on black" — it's the training-data reflex. Rework the scene sentence and color strategy until the answer is no longer obvious from the domain.

## Commands

| Command | Category | Description | Reference |
|---|---|---|---|
| `craft [feature]` | Build | Shape, then build a feature end-to-end | [reference/craft.md](reference/craft.md) |
| `shape [feature]` | Build | Plan UX/UI before writing code | [reference/shape.md](reference/shape.md) |
| `teach` | Build | Set up PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md context | [reference/teach.md](reference/teach.md) |
| `document` | Build | Generate DESIGN.md from existing project code | [reference/document.md](reference/document.md) |
| `extract [target]` | Build | Pull reusable tokens and components into design system | [reference/extract.md](reference/extract.md) |
| `critique [target]` | Evaluate | UX design review with heuristic scoring | [reference/critique.md](reference/critique.md) |
| `audit [target]` | Evaluate | Technical quality checks (a11y, perf, responsive) | [reference/audit.md](reference/audit.md) |
| `polish [target]` | Refine | Final quality pass before shipping | [reference/polish.md](reference/polish.md) |
| `bolder [target]` | Refine | Amplify safe or bland designs | [reference/bolder.md](reference/bolder.md) |
| `quieter [target]` | Refine | Tone down aggressive or overstimulating designs | [reference/quieter.md](reference/quieter.md) |
| `distill [target]` | Refine | Strip to essence, remove complexity | [reference/distill.md](reference/distill.md) |
| `harden [target]` | Refine | Production-ready: errors, i18n, edge cases | [reference/harden.md](reference/harden.md) |
| `onboard [target]` | Refine | Design first-run flows, empty states, activation | [reference/onboard.md](reference/onboard.md) |
| `animate [target]` | Enhance | Add purposeful animations and motion | [reference/animate.md](reference/animate.md) |
| `colorize [target]` | Enhance | Add strategic color to monochromatic UIs | [reference/colorize.md](reference/colorize.md) |
| `typeset [target]` | Enhance | Improve typography hierarchy and fonts | [reference/typeset.md](reference/typeset.md) |
| `layout [target]` | Enhance | Fix spacing, rhythm, and visual hierarchy | [reference/layout.md](reference/layout.md) |
| `delight [target]` | Enhance | Add personality and memorable touches | [reference/delight.md](reference/delight.md) |
| `overdrive [target]` | Enhance | Push past conventional limits | [reference/overdrive.md](reference/overdrive.md) |
| `clarify [target]` | Fix | Improve UX copy, labels, and error messages | [reference/clarify.md](reference/clarify.md) |
| `adapt [target]` | Fix | Adapt for different devices and screen sizes | [reference/adapt.md](reference/adapt.md) |
| `optimize [target]` | Fix | Diagnose and fix UI performance | [reference/optimize.md](reference/optimize.md) |
| `live` | Iterate | Visual variant mode: pick elements in the browser, generate alternatives | [reference/live.md](reference/live.md) |

Plus two management commands — `pin <command>` and `unpin <command>`, detailed below.

### Routing rules

1. **No argument** — render the table above as the user-facing command menu, grouped by category. Ask what they'd like to do.
2. **First word matches a command** — load its reference file and follow its instructions. Everything after the command name is the target.
3. **First word doesn't match** — general design invocation. Apply the setup steps, shared design laws, and the loaded register reference, using the full argument as context.

Setup (context gathering, register) is already loaded by then; sub-commands don't re-invoke `$impeccable`.

If the first word is `craft`, setup still runs first, but [reference/craft.md](reference/craft.md) owns the rest of the flow. If setup invokes `teach` as a blocker, finish teach, refresh context, then resume the original command and target.

## Pin / Unpin

**Pin** creates a standalone shortcut so `$<command>` invokes `$impeccable <command>` directly. **Unpin** removes it. The script writes to every harness directory present in the project.

```bash
node .agents/skills/impeccable/scripts/pin.mjs <pin|unpin> <command>
```

Valid `<command>` is any command from the table above. Report the script's result concisely — confirm the new shortcut on success, relay stderr verbatim on error.

1	# Teach Flow
2	
3	Gathers design context for a project and writes two complementary files at the project root:
4	
5	- **PRODUCT.md** (strategic): register, target users, product purpose, brand personality, anti-references, strategic design principles. Answers "who/what/why".
6	- **DESIGN.md** (visual): visual theme, color palette, typography, components, layout. Follows the [Google Stitch DESIGN.md format](https://stitch.withgoogle.com/docs/design-md/format/). Answers "how it looks".
7	
8	Every other impeccable command reads these files before doing any work.
9	
10	## Step 1: Load current state
11	
12	Run the shared loader first so you know what already exists:
13	
14	```bash
15	node .agents/skills/impeccable/scripts/load-context.mjs
16	```
17	
18	The output tells you whether PRODUCT.md and/or DESIGN.md already exist. If `migrated: true`, legacy `.impeccable.md` was auto-renamed to `PRODUCT.md`. Mention this once to the user.
19	
20	Decision tree:
21	- **Neither file exists (empty project or no context yet)**: do Steps 2-4 (write PRODUCT.md), then decide on DESIGN.md based on whether there's code to analyze.
22	- **PRODUCT.md exists, DESIGN.md missing**: skip to Step 5 — offer to run `$impeccable document` for DESIGN.md.
23	- **PRODUCT.md exists but has no `## Register` section (legacy)**: add it. Infer a hypothesis from the codebase (see Step 2), confirm with the user, write the field.
24	- **Both exist**: STOP and use Codex's structured user-input/question tool when available; if unavailable, ask directly in chat to clarify what you cannot infer. Ask which file to refresh. Skip the one the user doesn't want changed.
25	- **Just DESIGN.md exists (unusual)**: do Steps 2-4 to produce PRODUCT.md.
26	
27	Never silently overwrite an existing file. Always confirm first.
28	
29	If teach was invoked as a setup blocker by another command, such as `$impeccable craft landing page`, pause that command here. Complete teach, re-run the loader, then resume the original command with the freshly loaded context. For craft, resume into shape next; teach creates project context, but it is not a substitute for the task-specific shape interview and confirmed design brief.
30	
31	## Step 2: Explore the codebase
32	
33	Before asking questions, thoroughly scan the project to discover what you can:
34	
35	- **README and docs**: Project purpose, target audience, any stated goals
36	- **Package.json / config files**: Tech stack, dependencies, existing design libraries
37	- **Existing components**: Current design patterns, spacing, typography in use
38	- **Brand assets**: Logos, favicons, color values already defined
39	- **Design tokens / CSS variables**: Existing color palettes, font stacks, spacing scales
40	- **Any style guides or brand documentation**
41	
42	Also form a **register hypothesis** from what you find:
43	
44	- Brand signals: `/`, `/about`, `/pricing`, `/blog/*`, `/docs/*`, hero sections, big typography, scroll-driven sections, landing-page-shaped content.
45	- Product signals: `/app/*`, `/dashboard`, `/settings`, `/(auth)`, forms, data tables, side/top nav, app-shell components.
46	
47	Register is a hypothesis at this point, not a decision — Step 3 confirms it.
48	
49	Note what you've learned and what remains unclear. This exploration feeds both PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md.
50	
51	## Step 3: Ask strategic questions (for PRODUCT.md)
52	
53	STOP and use Codex's structured user-input/question tool when available; if unavailable, ask directly in chat to clarify what you cannot infer. Ask only about what you couldn't infer from the codebase.
54	
55	### Interview mode, not confirmation mode
56	
57	If the repo is empty or the user's brief is sparse, run a short interview before proposing PRODUCT.md. Do **not** turn a one-sentence request into a complete inferred PRODUCT.md and ask for blanket confirmation.
58	
59	- Use the harness's structured question tool when one exists. Otherwise, ask directly in chat and stop.
60	- Ask **2-3 questions per round**, then wait for answers.
61	- Use inferred answers as hypotheses or options, not as finished facts.
62	- Complete at least one real user-answer round before drafting PRODUCT.md, unless every required answer is directly discoverable from repo docs.

64	- Round 2 should establish brand personality or references, anti-references, and accessibility needs.
65	
66	### Minimum viable interview
67	
68	Ask enough to complete PRODUCT.md. 69	
70	### Register (ask first — it shapes everything below)
71	
72	Every design task is either **brand** (marketing, landing, campaign, long-form content, portfolio — design IS the product) or **product** (app UI, admin, dashboards, tools — design SERVES the product).
73	
74	If Step 2 produced a clear hypothesis, lead with it: *"From the codebase, this looks like a [brand / product] surface — does that match your intent, or should we treat it differently?"*
75	
76	If the signal is genuinely split (e.g. a product with a big marketing landing), STOP and use Codex's structured user-input/question tool when available; if unavailable, ask directly in chat to clarify what you cannot infer. Ask which register describes the **primary** surface. The register can be overridden per task later, but PRODUCT.md carries one default.
77	
78	### Users & Purpose
79	- Who uses this? What's their context when using it?
80	- What job are they trying to get done?
81	- For brand: what emotions should the interface evoke? (confidence, delight, calm, urgency)
82	- For product: what workflow are they in? What's the primary task on any given screen?
83

85	- How would you describe the brand personality in 3 words?
86	- Reference sites or apps that capture the right feel? What specifically about them?
87	  - For brand, push for real-world references in the right lane (tech-minimal, editorial-magazine, consumer-warm, brutalist-grid, etc.) — not generic "modern" adjectives.
88	  - For product, push for category best-tool references (Linear, Figma, Notion, Raycast, Stripe).
89	- What should this explicitly NOT look like? Any anti-references?
90	
91	### Accessibility & Inclusion
92	- Specific accessibility requirements? (WCAG level, known user needs)
93	- Considerations for reduced motion, color blindness, or other accommodations?
94	
95	Skip questions where the answer is already clear. **Do NOT ask about colors, fonts, radii, or visual styling here** — those belong in DESIGN.md, not PRODUCT.md.

98

1	# Product register
2	
3	When design SERVES the product: app UIs, admin dashboards, settings panels, data tables, tools, authenticated surfaces, anything where the user is in a task.
4	
5	## The product slop test
6	
7	Not "would someone say AI made this" — familiarity is often a feature here. The test is: would a user fluent in the category's best tools (Linear, Figma, Notion, Raycast, Stripe come to mind) sit down and trust this interface, or pause at every subtly-off component?
8	
9	Product UI's failure mode isn't flatness, it's strangeness without purpose: over-decorated buttons, mismatched form controls, gratuitous motion, display fonts where labels should be, invented affordances for standard tasks. The bar is earned familiarity. The tool should disappear into the task.
10	
11	## Typography
12	
13	- **System fonts are legitimate.** `-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif` gives you native feel on every platform. Inter is the common cross-platform default for a reason.
14	- **One family is often right.** Product UIs don't need display/body pairing. A well-tuned sans carries headings, buttons, labels, body, data.
15	- **Fixed rem scale, not fluid.** Clamp-sized headings don't serve product UI. Users view at consistent DPI, and a fluid h1 that shrinks in a sidebar looks worse, not better.
16	- **Tighter scale ratio.** 1.125–1.2 between steps is typical. More type elements here than on brand surfaces; exaggerated contrast creates noise.
17	- **Line length still applies for prose** (65–75ch). Data and compact UI can run denser — tables at 120ch+ are fine.
18	
19	## Color
20	
21	Product defaults to Restrained. A single surface can earn Committed — a dashboard where one category color carries a report, an onboarding flow with a drenched welcome screen — but Restrained is the floor.
22	
23	- State-rich semantic vocabulary: hover, focus, active, disabled, selected, loading, error, warning, success, info. Standardize these.
24	- Accent color used for primary actions, current selection, and state indicators only — not decoration.
25	- A second neutral layer for sidebars, toolbars, and panels (slightly cooler or warmer than the content surface).
26	
27	## Layout
28	
29	- Predictable grids. Consistency IS an affordance — users navigate faster when the structure is expected.
30	- Familiar patterns are features. Standard navigation (top bar, side nav), breadcrumbs, tabs, and form layouts have established user expectations. Don't reinvent for flavor.
31	- Responsive behavior is structural (collapse sidebar, responsive table, breakpoint-driven columns), not fluid typography.
32	
33	## Components
34	
35	Every interactive component has: default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, error. Don't ship with half of these.
36	
37	- Skeleton states for loading, not spinners in the middle of content.
38	- Empty states that teach the interface, not "nothing here."
39	- Consistent affordances across the surface. Same button shape. Same form-control vocabulary. Same icon style.
40	
41	## Motion
42	
43	- 150–250 ms on most transitions. Users are in flow — don't make them wait for choreography.
44	- Motion conveys state, not decoration. State change, feedback, loading, reveal — nothing else.
45	- No orchestrated page-load sequences. Product loads into a task; users don't want to watch it load.
46	
47	## Product bans (on top of the shared absolute bans)
48	
49	- Decorative motion that doesn't convey state.
50	- Inconsistent component vocabulary across screens. If the "save" button looks different in two places, one is wrong.
51	- Display fonts in UI labels, buttons, data.
52	- Reinventing standard affordances for flavor (custom scrollbars, weird form controls, non-standard modals).
53	- Heavy color or full-saturation accents on inactive states.
54	
55	## Product permissions
56	
57	Product can afford things brand surfaces can't.
58	
59	- System fonts and familiar sans defaults (Inter, SF Pro, system-ui stacks).
60	- Standard navigation patterns: top bar + side nav, breadcrumbs, tabs, command palettes.
61	- Density. Tables with many rows, panels with many labels, dense information when users need it.
62	- Consistency over surprise. The same visual vocabulary screen to screen is a virtue; delight is saved for moments, not pages.

python -c "
import base64,gzip,json
for f in ['dbt','dagster','entire']:
  t=open('docs/examples/'+f+'.txt').read().strip()
  k=t.find('#r=')
  if k>=0: t=t[k+3:]
  t=t.replace('-','+').replace('_','/'); t+='='*(-len(t)%4)
  o=json.loads(gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(t)))
  print('=====',f, o['status'], o.get('verify'), o.get('trace_id'), o.get('tags'))
  print(o['diff'][-1200:])
  print([ (s['id'],s['status'],s['attempts']) for s in o['steps']])
"

.err{color:var(--bad);margin-top:12px;font-size:14px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start}
.gal{margin-top:40px}
.gal h2{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink2);margin-bottom:10px}
.gal ul{list-style:none;padding:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.gal li+li{border-top:1px solid var(--line2)}
.gal button{display:grid;grid-template-columns:18px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:3px 12px;align-items:start;width:100%;padding:14px 16px;border:0;background:none;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}
.gal button:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.gal .gt{font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px}
.gal .gs{grid-column:2;color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.45}
.gal .gm{font:12px var(--mono);color:var(--mut);white-space:nowrap;padding-top:2px}
.gal svg.i{margin-top:2px}

/* loading */
.skel{padding:40px 0}
.skel i{display:block;height:14px;border-radius:6px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--line2),var(--sunk),var(--line2));background-size:200% 100%;animation:sh 1.2s linear infinite;margin-bottom:12px}
@keyframes sh{to{background-position:-200% 0}}

/* run header */
.rh{padding:28px 0 0}
.rh-top{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.rh-k{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
.rh-k .mono{font-size:12px}
.rh h1{font-size:28px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.025em;font-weight:700;margin-top:8px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;max-width:30ch}
.rh-acts{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:24px;padding:0 9px;border-radius:99px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink2);background:var(--panel)}
.badge .dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--faint)}
.badge.ok{color:var(--ok);background:var(--ok-bg);border-color:transparent}.badge.ok .dot{background:var(--ok)}
.badge.bad{color:var(--bad);background:var(--bad-bg);border-color:transparent}.badge.bad .dot{background:var(--bad)}
.badge.warn{color:var(--warn);background:var(--warn-bg);border-color:transparent}.badge.warn .dot{background:var(--warn-dot)}
.facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));margin-top:22px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.facts>div{padding:13px 16px;min-width:0}
.facts>div+div{border-left:1px solid var(--line2)}
.facts>div:nth-child(5){border-left:0}
.facts>div:nth-child(n+5){border-top:1px solid var(--line2)}
.facts dt{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.facts dd{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600;margin-top:3px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.facts dd .mono{font-size:13px;font-weight:500}
.facts dd small{font-weight:400;color:var(--mut);font-size:12.5px}
.facts dd a{color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.facts dd a:hover{color:var(--acc);text-decoration:underline}

/* tabs */
.tabs{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;margin-top:22px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);position:sticky;top:56px;z-index:30;background:var(--bg)}
.tab{position:relative;height:42px;padding:0 12px;border:0;background:none;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mut);cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.tab:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.tab[aria-selected=true]{color:var(--ink)}
.tab[aria-selected=true]::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:8px;right:8px;bottom:-1px;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--ink)}
.tabs .sp{flex:1}
.tabs .hint{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}

/* shell */
.shell{display:grid;grid-template-columns:248px minmax(0,1fr);gap:36px;padding:24px 0 40px;align-items:start}
.rail{position:sticky;top:122px}
.rail h2{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut);letter-spacing:.02em;padding:0 10px 8px}
.rail ol{list-style:none;padding:0;position:relative}
.rail li{position:relative}
.rail li+li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:19px;top:-9px;height:18px;width:1.5px;background:var(--line)}
.rail li.done+li::before{background:var(--ok-mk)}
.rb{display:grid;grid-template-columns:20px minmax(0,1fr);gap:1px 10px;align-items:center;width:100%;padding:8px 10px;border:0;background:none;border-radius:9px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink2)}
.rb:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.rb[aria-current=step]{background:var(--panel);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line),var(--sh);color:var(--ink)}
.rb .rt{font-size:14px;font-weight:500}
.rb .rs{grid-column:2;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.rb svg.i{width:18px;height:18px;position:relative;z-index:1;background:var(--bg);border-radius:50%}
.rb[aria-current=step] svg.i{background:var(--panel)}
.rail .meter{margin:16px 10px 0;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.rail .meter i{display:block;height:4px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--line2);margin-top:6px;overflow:hidden}
.rail .meter b{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--acc);border-radius:4px;transition:width .3s var(--ease)}

/* status icons */
.s-ok{color:var(--ok)}.s-bad{color:var(--bad)}.s-warn{color:var(--warn-dot)}.s-skip,.s-q{color:var(--faint)}.s-acc{color:var(--acc)}
.spin{animation:spin .9s linear infinite;color:var(--acc)}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}

/* stages */
.stg{scroll-margin-top:120px}
.walk .stg{display:none}
.walk .stg.on{display:block;animation:in .22s var(--ease) both}
.report .stg+.stg{margin-top:56px;padding-top:40px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
@keyframes in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.sh{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:18px}
.sh .ey{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);font-weight:500;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.sh h2{font-size:22px;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-weight:700;margin-top:4px}
.sh h2:focus{outline:0}
.sh p{color:var(--ink2);font-size:15px;margin-top:6px;max-width:68ch}
.sh .sa{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}

/* code block */
.cb{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--panel);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.cb+.cb,.cb+p,.cb+.why{margin-top:12px}
.cb-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:38px;padding:4px 6px 4px 12px;background:var(--sunk);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.cb-h .cn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;min-width:0;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink2);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.cb-h .cn .mono{font-size:12px}
.cb-h .sp{flex:1}
.cb-b{overflow-x:auto;padding:8px 0;font:13px/1.7 var(--mono);color:var(--ink)}
.cb-b.tall{max-height:360px;overflow-y:auto}
.ln{display:grid;grid-template-columns:46px minmax(0,1fr);min-width:max-content}
.ln .n{color:var(--faint);text-align:right;padding-right:14px;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
.ln .t{white-space:pre;padding-right:20px}
.wrapl .ln{min-width:0}
.wrapl .ln .t{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.ln .t .p{color:var(--faint);user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
.ln.err{background:var(--bad-bg)}
.ln.err .t{color:var(--bad)}
.ln.err .n{color:var(--bad)}
.cb-more{display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:6px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);background:var(--sunk)}
/* diff */
.dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 44px 22px minmax(0,1fr);min-width:max-content}
.dl .n{color:var(--faint);text-align:right;padding-right:10px;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
.dl .g{user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;text-align:center;color:var(--faint)}
.dl .t{white-space:pre;padding-right:20px}
.wrapl .dl{min-width:0}.wrapl .dl .t{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.dl.a{background:var(--ok-bg)}.dl.a .n{background:var(--ok-ln);color:var(--ok)}.dl.a .g{color:var(--ok)}
.dl.d{background:var(--bad-bg)}.dl.d .n{background:var(--bad-ln);color:var(--bad)}.dl.d .g{color:var(--bad)}
.dl.a mark{background:var(--ok-mk);color:inherit;border-radius:3px}
.dl.d mark{background:var(--bad-mk);color:inherit;border-radius:3px}
.dl.hk{background:var(--acc-bg);color:var(--acc-d)}.dl.hk .n{color:var(--acc)}
.dl.nt .t{color:var(--mut)}
.dstat{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font:12px var(--mono)}
.dstat .a{color:var(--ok)}.dstat .d{color:var(--bad)}
.dstat i{display:inline-flex;gap:2px}
.dstat i b{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--line)}
.dstat i b.a{background:var(--ok)}.dstat i b.d{background:var(--bad)}

/* read stage */
.browser{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.bw-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;height:40px;padding:0 12px;background:var(--sunk);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.bw-bar .dots{display:flex;gap:6px}.bw-bar .dots i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line)}
.bw-url{flex:1;min-width:0;height:26px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line2);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:0 9px;font:12.5px var(--mono);color:var(--ink2);overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap}
.bw-url span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.bw-body{padding:22px 22px 24px}
.bw-body h3{font-size:20px;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.25}
.bw-body .found{margin-top:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.bw-body .found code{display:block;font-size:12.5px;background:var(--sunk);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:7px;padding:6px 10px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;color:var(--ink2)}
.bw-body .found code mark{background:var(--acc-bg);color:var(--acc-d);border-radius:4px;padding:0 4px;margin-right:6px;font-weight:600}
.kv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0;margin-top:16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel)}
.kv>div{padding:12px 16px;min-width:0}
.kv>div:not(:nth-child(3n+1)){border-left:1px solid var(--line2)}
.kv>div:nth-child(n+4){border-top:1px solid var(--line2)}
.kv dt{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.kv dd{font-size:14px;font-weight:500;margin-top:2px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}

/* plan */
.plan{list-style:none;padding:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);box-shadow:var(--sh);overflow:hidden;counter-reset:p}
.plan li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:28px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:2px 12px;padding:12px 16px;align-items:baseline}
.plan li+li{border-top:1px solid var(--line2)}
.plan .pn{font:600 12.5px var(--mono);color:var(--mut);text-align:right}
.plan .pi{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:500}
.plan code{grid-column:2;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;display:block}
.plan .pk{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.plan li.skip .pi{color:var(--mut)}
.plan li.skip .why2{grid-column:2;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}

/* run */
.sum{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px}
.segs{display:flex;gap:3px;flex:1;min-width:220px}
.segs button{flex:1;height:10px;border:0;border-radius:3px;background:var(--line);cursor:pointer;padding:0;transition:transform .15s var(--ease)}
.segs button:hover{transform:scaleY(1.5)}
.segs button.ok{background:var(--ok)}.segs button.fix{background:var(--warn-dot)}.segs button.bad{background:var(--bad)}.segs button.skip{background:var(--line)}.segs button.run{background:var(--acc)}
.legend{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.legend span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.legend i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:2px;display:inline-block}
.steps{list-style:none;padding:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);box-shadow:var(--sh);overflow:hidden}
.steps>li+li{border-top:1px solid var(--line2)}
.st-h{display:grid;grid-template-columns:14px 18px 30px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;width:100%;padding:11px 14px;border:0;background:none;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}
.st-h:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.st-h:focus-visible{outline-offset:-2px}
.st-h .cv{color:var(--faint);transition:transform .18s var(--ease)}
.st-h[aria-expanded=true] .cv{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.st-h .sn{font:500 12.5px var(--mono);color:var(--mut)}
.st-h .tx{min-width:0}
.st-h .ti{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:500;display:block;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.st-h .tc{display:block;font:12.5px var(--mono);color:var(--mut);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;margin-top:1px}
.st-h .mt{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:12.5px var(--mono);color:var(--mut);white-space:nowrap}
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:20px;padding:0 7px;border-radius:99px;font:600 11.5px Geist,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;background:var(--sunk);color:var(--ink2);border:1px solid var(--line2)}
.chip.warn{background:var(--warn-bg);color:var(--warn);border-color:transparent}
.chip.bad{background:var(--bad-bg);color:var(--bad);border-color:transparent}
.chip.ok{background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok);border-color:transparent}
.chip.acc{background:var(--acc-bg);color:var(--acc-d);border-color:transparent}
.st-b{padding:2px 16px 16px 86px;display:grid;gap:12px}
.st-b .note{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink2)}
.st-b .note a{font-weight:500}
.steps>li.live{background:var(--acc-bg)}
.steps>li.q .st-h{opacity:.5}

/* fix */
.fix+.fix{margin-top:36px;padding-top:32px;border-top:1px solid var(--line2)}
.fx-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.fx-h h3{font-size:17px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.fx-g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 260px;gap:20px;margin-top:14px;align-items:start}
.why{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.6;max-width:72ch}
.why a{font-weight:500}
.cls{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);padding:14px 16px;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.cls h4{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut)}
.bars{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:8px 10px;margin-top:10px;align-items:center;font-size:12.5px}
.bars .k{font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--mut)}
.bars .k.top{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.bars .v{font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--mut);text-align:right}
.trk{height:6px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--line2);overflow:hidden}
.trk i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;border-radius:6px;background:var(--faint);transition:width .5s var(--ease)}
.trk i.top{background:var(--acc)}
.cls small{display:block;margin-top:10px;color:var(--mut);font-size:12px}
.gave{margin-top:16px;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--warn-bg);color:var(--warn);font-size:14px}

/* prove */
.verdict{display:grid;grid-template-columns:48px minmax(0,1fr);gap:4px 16px;align-items:start;padding:22px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.verdict .vi{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;grid-row:span 3}
.verdict .vi svg.i{width:24px;height:24px;stroke-width:2.2}
.verdict.ok .vi{background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok)}
.verdict.bad .vi{background:var(--bad-bg);color:var(--bad)}
.verdict.warn .vi{background:var(--warn-bg);color:var(--warn)}
.verdict h3{font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.015em;line-height:1.3}
.verdict p{color:var(--ink2);font-size:14.5px;max-width:68ch}
.cells{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
.cells i{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:5px;background:var(--line2);display:grid;place-items:center;font:600 10.5px var(--mono);color:var(--mut);font-style:normal}
.cells i.ok{background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ok-ln)}
.cells i.bad{background:var(--bad-bg);color:var(--bad)}
.pv-why{margin-top:16px;font-size:14px;color:var(--mut);max-width:72ch}

/* bisect */
.tl{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:26px 20px 18px;overflow-x:auto}
.tlr{display:flex;position:relative;min-width:max-content}
.tlr::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:36px;right:36px;top:31px;height:2px;background:var(--line)}
.rel{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:5px;min-width:96px;flex:1;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
.rel .tg{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--bad);min-height:15px;letter-spacing:.02em}
.rel i{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--faint);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--panel);position:relative}
.rel.p i{background:var(--ok)}.rel.f i{background:var(--bad)}
.rel.first i{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--panel),0 0 0 7px var(--bad-ln)}
.rel b{font:600 12.5px var(--mono);color:var(--ink)}
.rel.first b{color:var(--bad)}
.rel.anim{opacity:.25;transition:opacity .3s var(--ease)}
.rel.anim.on{opacity:1}
.nt-row{margin-top:16px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.nt-row i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line);display:inline-block}
.tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);overflow:hidden;font-size:13.5px;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.tbl th{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut);text-align:left;padding:9px 14px;background:var(--sunk);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.tbl td{padding:10px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line2);vertical-align:top;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.tbl tr:first-child td{border-top:0}
.tbl td.mono{font-size:12.5px}
.tbl .res{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap}
.tbl tr.first td{background:var(--bad-bg)}
.call{margin-top:14px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--sunk);border:1px solid var(--line2);font-size:14.5px}
.call b{font-weight:600}
.call small{display:block;color:var(--mut);font-size:13px;margin-top:3px}
.mt16{margin-top:16px}

/* prereqs */
.pq-st{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;margin-top:14px;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:500}
.pq-st small{display:block;color:var(--mut);font-weight:400;font-size:13px;margin-top:2px}

/* footer */
.foot{border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:8px;background:var(--panel)}
.foot-in{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:28px 20px 36px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:20px 40px;align-items:end}
.foot h2{font-size:15px;font-weight:600}
.foot p{color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px;margin-top:2px}
.cmdbox{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:12px;max-width:620px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--sunk);padding:6px 6px 6px 14px}
.cmdbox code{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow-x:auto;white-space:nowrap;font-size:13.5px;padding:4px 0}
.cmdbox .p{color:var(--faint)}
.foot nav{display:flex;gap:18px;font-size:13.5px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.foot nav a{color:var(--mut);text-decoration:none}
.foot nav a:hover{color:var(--ink)}

/* pager */
.pager{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-top:32px;padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.pager .pd{display:flex;gap:6px}

.b.ico{width:34px;padding:0}
.b.sm.ico{width:28px}
kbd{font:500 11.5px/1 var(--mono);color:var(--mut);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom-width:2px;border-radius:5px;padding:3px 5px;min-width:20px;display:inline-block;text-align:center}

/* top bar */
.top{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:40;height:56px;background:oklch(99.4% .002 255/.86);-webkit-backdrop-filter:saturate(1.6) blur(14px);backdrop-filter:saturate(1.6) blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.top-in{max-width:1280px;height:100%;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:-.01em;flex:none}
.brand svg{width:26px;height:26px}
.crumbs{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:0;font-size:14px;color:var(--mut)}
.crumbs .sl{color:var(--line);font-size:20px;font-weight:300}
.crumbs a{color:var(--mut);text-decoration:none}
.crumbs a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.crumbs .now{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.top .sp{flex:1}
.top .acts{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex:none}
.anch{position:relative}

/* popovers */
.pop{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 8px);right:0;z-index:60;min-width:280px;max-width:min(380px,calc(100vw - 24px));background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--sh2);padding:6px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-4px);pointer-events:none;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .15s var(--ease),transform .15s var(--ease),visibility 0s .15s}
.pop.on{opacity:1;transform:none;pointer-events:auto;visibility:visible;transition:opacity .15s var(--ease),transform .15s var(--ease)}
.pop .ph{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut);padding:8px 10px 6px;letter-spacing:.01em}
.mi{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;padding:8px 10px;border:0;background:none;border-radius:8px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}
.mi:hover,.mi:focus-visible{background:var(--hover);outline:0}
.mi .mt{min-width:0;flex:1}
.mi .mt small{display:block;color:var(--mut);font-size:12.5px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.mi .k{margin-left:auto;color:var(--mut);font-size:12px;font-family:var(--mono)}
.mi[aria-current=true]{background:var(--acc-bg)}
.pop hr{border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line2);margin:6px 4px}
.linkrow{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:4px 4px 8px}
.linkrow input{flex:1;min-width:0;height:32px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;background:var(--sunk);padding:0 9px;font:12.5px var(--mono);color:var(--ink2)}

/* toast */
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:24px;z-index:80;transform:translate(-50%,12px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;background:var(--ink);color:oklch(98% .004 255);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:99px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;box-shadow:var(--sh2);transition:opacity .2s var(--ease),transform .2s var(--ease)}
.toast.on{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
.toast svg.i{color:var(--ok-mk)}

/* page */
.wrap{max-width:1280px;width:100%;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
main{flex:1}

/* input view */
.intro{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;padding:56px 20px 64px}
.intro h1{font-size:32px;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.03em;font-weight:700}
.intro .lede{font-size:16px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:8px;max-width:60ch}
.paste{margin-top:24px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);box-shadow:var(--sh);overflow:hidden}
.paste:focus-within{border-color:var(--acc);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--acc-bg)}
.paste textarea{display:block;width:100%;min-height:120px;border:0;resize:vertical;padding:14px 16px;font:13.5px/1.6 var(--mono);color:var(--ink);background:transparent}
.paste textarea:focus{outline:0}
.paste .pf{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:8px 8px 8px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line2);background:var(--sunk);font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.paste .pf kbd{background:transparent;color:inherit;border-color:oklch(100% 0 0/.45)}
.err{color:var(--bad);margin-top:12px;font-size:14px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start}
.gal{margin-top:40px}
.gal h2{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink2);margin-bottom:10px}
.gal ul{list-style:none;padding:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.gal li+li{border-top:1px solid var(--line2)}
.gal button{display:grid;grid-template-columns:18px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:3px 12px;align-items:start;width:100%;padding:14px 16px;border:0;background:none;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}
.gal button:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.gal .gt{font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px}
.gal .gs{grid-column:2;color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.45}
.gal .gm{font:12px var(--mono);color:var(--mut);white-space:nowrap;padding-top:2px}
.gal svg.i{margin-top:2px}

/* loading */
.skel{padding:40px 0}
.skel i{display:block;height:14px;border-radius:6px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--line2),var(--sunk),var(--line2));background-size:200% 100%;animation:sh 1.2s linear infinite;margin-bottom:12px}
@keyframes sh{to{background-position:-200% 0}}

/* run header */
.rh{padding:28px 0 0}
.rh-top{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.rh-k{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
.rh-k .mono{font-size:12px}
.rh h1{font-size:28px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.025em;font-weight:700;margin-top:8px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;max-width:30ch}
.rh-acts{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:24px;padding:0 9px;border-radius:99px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink2);background:var(--panel)}
.badge .dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--faint)}
.badge.ok{color:var(--ok);background:var(--ok-bg);border-color:transparent}.badge.ok .dot{background:var(--ok)}
.badge.bad{color:var(--bad);background:var(--bad-bg);border-color:transparent}.badge.bad .dot{background:var(--bad)}
.badge.warn{color:var(--warn);background:var(--warn-bg);border-color:transparent}.badge.warn .dot{background:var(--warn-dot)}
.facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));margin-top:22px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.facts>div{padding:13px 16px;min-width:0}
.facts>div+div{border-left:1px solid var(--line2)}
.facts>div:nth-child(5){border-left:0}
.facts>div:nth-child(n+5){border-top:1px solid var(--line2)}
.facts dt{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.facts dd{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600;margin-top:3px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.facts dd .mono{font-size:13px;font-weight:500}
.facts dd span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.facts dd small{font-weight:400;color:var(--mut);font-size:12.5px;white-space:nowrap}
.facts dd a{color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.facts dd a:hover{color:var(--acc);text-decoration:underline}
.links{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-top:12px}
.links .lh{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-right:2px}
.lk{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:28px;padding:0 10px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink2);text-decoration:none;max-width:340px;cursor:pointer}
.lk span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.lk:hover{border-color:var(--faint);color:var(--ink);background:var(--hover)}
.lk svg.i{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--mut)}
.lk .lock{font-size:11px;color:var(--mut);font-weight:500;border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:6px;margin-left:2px}

/* tabs */
.tabs{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;margin-top:22px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);position:sticky;top:56px;z-index:30;background:var(--bg)}
.tab{position:relative;height:42px;padding:0 12px;border:0;background:none;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mut);cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.tab:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.tab[aria-selected=true]{color:var(--ink)}
.tab[aria-selected=true]::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:8px;right:8px;bottom:-1px;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--ink)}
.tabs .sp{flex:1}
.tabs .hint{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}

/* shell */
.shell{display:grid;grid-template-columns:248px minmax(0,1fr);gap:36px;padding:24px 0 40px;align-items:start}
.rail{position:sticky;top:122px}
.rail h2{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut);letter-spacing:.02em;padding:0 10px 8px}
.rail ol{list-style:none;padding:0;position:relative}
.rail li{position:relative}
.rail li+li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:19px;top:-9px;height:18px;width:1.5px;background:var(--line)}
.rail li.done+li::before{background:var(--ok-mk)}
.rb{display:grid;grid-template-columns:20px minmax(0,1fr);gap:1px 10px;align-items:center;width:100%;padding:8px 10px;border:0;background:none;border-radius:9px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink2)}
.rb:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.rb[aria-current=step]{background:var(--panel);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line),var(--sh);color:var(--ink)}
.rb .rt{font-size:14px;font-weight:500}
.rb .rs{grid-column:2;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.rb svg.i{width:18px;height:18px;position:relative;z-index:1;background:var(--bg);border-radius:50%}
.rb[aria-current=step] svg.i{background:var(--panel)}
.rail .meter{margin:16px 10px 0;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.rail .meter i{display:block;height:4px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--line2);margin-top:6px;overflow:hidden}
.rail .meter b{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--acc);border-radius:4px;transition:width .3s var(--ease)}

/* status icons */
.s-ok{color:var(--ok)}.s-bad{color:var(--bad)}.s-warn{color:var(--warn-dot)}.s-skip,.s-q{color:var(--faint)}.s-acc{color:var(--acc)}
.spin{animation:spin .9s linear infinite;color:var(--acc)}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}

/* stages */
.stg{scroll-margin-top:120px}
.walk .stg{display:none}
.walk .stg.on{display:block;animation:in .22s var(--ease) both}
.report .stg+.stg{margin-top:56px;padding-top:40px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
@keyframes in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.sh{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:18px}
.sh .ey{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);font-weight:500}
.sh h2{font-size:22px;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-weight:700;margin-top:4px}
.sh h2:focus{outline:0}
.sh p{color:var(--ink2);font-size:15px;margin-top:6px;max-width:68ch}
.sh .sa{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}

/* code block */
.cb{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--panel);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.cb-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:38px;padding:4px 6px 4px 12px;background:var(--sunk);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.cb-h .cn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;min-width:0;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink2);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.cb-h .cn .mono{font-size:12px}
.cb-h .sp{flex:1}
.cb-b{overflow-x:auto;padding:8px 0;font:13px/1.7 var(--mono);color:var(--ink)}
.cb-b.tall{max-height:360px;overflow-y:auto}
.ln{display:grid;grid-template-columns:46px minmax(0,1fr);min-width:max-content}
.ln .n{color:var(--faint);text-align:right;padding-right:14px;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
.ln .t{white-space:pre;padding-right:20px}
.wrapl .ln{min-width:0}
.wrapl .ln .t{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.ln .t .p{color:var(--faint);user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
.ln.err{background:var(--bad-bg)}
.ln.err .t{color:var(--bad)}
.ln.err .n{color:var(--bad)}
.cb-more{display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:6px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);background:var(--sunk)}
/* diff */
.dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 44px 22px minmax(0,1fr);min-width:max-content}
.dl .n{color:var(--faint);text-align:right;padding-right:10px;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
.dl .g{user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;text-align:center;color:var(--faint)}
.dl .t{white-space:pre;padding-right:20px}
.wrapl .dl{min-width:0}.wrapl .dl .t{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.dl.a{background:var(--ok-bg)}.dl.a .n{background:var(--ok-ln);color:var(--ok)}.dl.a .g{color:var(--ok)}
.dl.d{background:var(--bad-bg)}.dl.d .n{background:var(--bad-ln);color:var(--bad)}.dl.d .g{color:var(--bad)}
.dl.a mark{background:var(--ok-mk);color:inherit;border-radius:3px}
.dl.d mark{background:var(--bad-mk);color:inherit;border-radius:3px}
.dl.hk{background:var(--acc-bg);color:var(--acc-d)}.dl.hk .n{color:var(--acc)}
.dl.nt .t{color:var(--mut)}
.dstat{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font:12px var(--mono)}
.dstat .a{color:var(--ok)}.dstat .d{color:var(--bad)}
.dstat i{display:inline-flex;gap:2px}
.dstat i b{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--line)}
.dstat i b.a{background:var(--ok)}.dstat i b.d{background:var(--bad)}

/* quote */
.quote{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:4px 10px;align-items:start;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--sunk);border:1px solid var(--line2);font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink)}
.quote .qk{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut);grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.quote blockquote{grid-column:1/-1;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.quote mark{background:var(--bad-bg);color:var(--bad);border-radius:4px;padding:0 3px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.92em}

/* read stage */
.browser{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.bw-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;height:40px;padding:0 6px 0 12px;background:var(--sunk);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.bw-bar .dots{display:flex;gap:6px}.bw-bar .dots i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line)}
.bw-url{flex:1;min-width:0;height:26px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line2);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:0 9px;font:12.5px var(--mono);color:var(--ink2);overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap}
.bw-url span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.bw-url svg.i{width:13px;height:13px;color:var(--faint)}
.bw-body{padding:22px 22px 24px}
.bw-body h3{font-size:20px;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.25}
.bw-body .found{margin-top:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.bw-body .found code{display:block;font-size:12.5px;background:var(--sunk);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:7px;padding:6px 10px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;color:var(--ink2)}
.bw-body .found code mark{background:var(--acc-bg);color:var(--acc-d);border-radius:4px;padding:0 5px;margin-right:8px;font-weight:600}
.kv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));margin-top:16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel)}
.kv>div{padding:12px 16px;min-width:0}
.kv>div:not(:nth-child(3n+1)){border-left:1px solid var(--line2)}
.kv>div:nth-child(n+4){border-top:1px solid var(--line2)}
.kv dt{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.kv dd{font-size:14px;font-weight:500;margin-top:2px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}

/* plan */
.plan{list-style:none;padding:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);box-shadow:var(--sh);overflow:hidden}
.plan li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:28px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:2px 12px;padding:12px 16px;align-items:baseline}
.plan li+li{border-top:1px solid var(--line2)}
.plan .pn{font:600 12.5px var(--mono);color:var(--mut);text-align:right}
.plan .pi{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:500}
.plan code{grid-column:2;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;display:block}
.plan .pk{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.plan li.skip .pi{color:var(--mut)}
.plan li.skip .why2{grid-column:2;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}

/* run */
.sum{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px}
.segs{display:flex;gap:3px;flex:1;min-width:220px}
.segs button{flex:1;height:10px;border:0;border-radius:3px;background:var(--line);cursor:pointer;padding:0;transition:transform .15s var(--ease)}
.segs button:hover{transform:scaleY(1.5)}
.segs button.ok{background:var(--ok)}.segs button.fix{background:var(--warn-dot)}.segs button.bad{background:var(--bad)}.segs button.skip{background:var(--line)}.segs button.run{background:var(--acc)}
.legend{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.legend span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.legend i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:2px;display:inline-block}
.steps{list-style:none;padding:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);box-shadow:var(--sh);overflow:hidden}
.steps>li+li{border-top:1px solid var(--line2)}
.st-h{display:grid;grid-template-columns:14px 18px 30px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;width:100%;padding:11px 14px;border:0;background:none;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}
.st-h:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.st-h:focus-visible{outline-offset:-2px}
.st-h .cv{color:var(--faint);transition:transform .18s var(--ease)}
.st-h[aria-expanded=true] .cv{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.st-h .sn{font:500 12.5px var(--mono);color:var(--mut)}
.st-h .tx{min-width:0}
.st-h .ti{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:500;display:block;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.st-h .tc{display:block;font:12.5px var(--mono);color:var(--mut);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;margin-top:1px}
.st-h .mt{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:12.5px var(--mono);color:var(--mut);white-space:nowrap}
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;height:20px;padding:0 7px;border-radius:99px;font:600 11.5px Geist,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;background:var(--sunk);color:var(--ink2);border:1px solid var(--line2);white-space:nowrap}
.chip.warn{background:var(--warn-bg);color:var(--warn);border-color:transparent}
.chip.bad{background:var(--bad-bg);color:var(--bad);border-color:transparent}
.chip.ok{background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok);border-color:transparent}
.chip.acc{background:var(--acc-bg);color:var(--acc-d);border-color:transparent}
.st-b{padding:2px 16px 18px 86px;display:grid;gap:12px}
.st-b .note{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink2)}
.st-b .note a{font-weight:500}
.st-b .foot2{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.steps>li.live{background:var(--acc-bg)}
.steps>li.q .st-h{opacity:.5}
.steps>li.hl{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--acc-ln)}
.att{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);font-weight:500}
.att b{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink2)}

/* fix */
.fix+.fix{margin-top:36px;padding-top:32px;border-top:1px solid var(--line2)}
.fx-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.fx-h h3{font-size:17px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.fx-g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 260px;gap:20px;margin-top:14px;align-items:start}
.fx-g>div{min-width:0;display:grid;gap:12px}
.why{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.6;max-width:72ch}
.why a{font-weight:500}
.cls{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);padding:14px 16px;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.cls h4{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut)}
.bars{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:8px 10px;margin-top:10px;align-items:center;font-size:12.5px}
.bars .k{font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--mut)}
.bars .k.top{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.bars .v{font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--mut);text-align:right}
.trk{height:6px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--line2);overflow:hidden}
.trk i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;border-radius:6px;background:var(--faint);transition:width .5s var(--ease)}
.trk i.top{background:var(--acc)}
.cls small{display:block;margin-top:10px;color:var(--mut);font-size:12px}
.gave{margin-top:16px;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--warn-bg);color:var(--warn);font-size:14px}

/* prove */
.verdict{display:grid;grid-template-columns:48px minmax(0,1fr);gap:4px 16px;align-items:start;padding:22px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.verdict .vi{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;grid-row:span 3}
.verdict .vi svg.i{width:24px;height:24px;stroke-width:2.2}
.verdict.ok .vi{background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok)}
.verdict.bad .vi{background:var(--bad-bg);color:var(--bad)}
.verdict.warn .vi{background:var(--warn-bg);color:var(--warn)}
.verdict h3{font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.015em;line-height:1.3}
.verdict p{color:var(--ink2);font-size:14.5px;max-width:68ch}
.cells{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
.cells i{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:5px;background:var(--line2);display:grid;place-items:center;font:600 10.5px var(--mono);color:var(--mut);font-style:normal}
.cells i.ok{background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ok-ln)}
.cells i.bad{background:var(--bad-bg);color:var(--bad)}
.pv-why{margin-top:16px;font-size:14px;color:var(--mut);max-width:72ch}

/* graph */
.gtop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px 20px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:14px}
.segc{display:inline-flex;padding:3px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--line2);gap:2px}
.segc button{border:0;background:none;height:28px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:7px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mut);cursor:pointer}
.segc button:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.segc button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.gkey{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 14px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.gkey span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.gkey i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block}
.gwrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 400px;gap:20px;align-items:start}
.gwrap.wide{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
.gwrap.wide .gpan{display:none}
.gbox{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);box-shadow:var(--sh);min-width:0}
.graph{list-style:none;padding:14px 12px 14px 16px}
.graph>li{position:relative;padding-left:32px}
.graph>li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:10px;top:0;bottom:0;width:1.5px;background:var(--line)}
.graph>li:first-child::before{top:20px}
.graph>li:last-child::before{bottom:auto;height:20px}
.gb{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:2px 12px;width:100%;padding:9px 12px;border:0;background:none;border-radius:9px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;position:relative;min-height:44px}
.gb:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.gb[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--acc-bg);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--acc-ln)}
.gd{position:absolute;left:-32px;top:11px;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:oklch(99% 0 0);background:var(--faint);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--panel);font:700 11px var(--mono)}
.gd svg.i{width:12px;height:12px;stroke-width:2.4}
.gs{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut)}
.gc{grid-column:1;font-size:13.5px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;white-space:pre-wrap;color:var(--ink)}
.gc.mono{font-size:12.5px}
.gr{grid-column:2;grid-row:1/3;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;gap:4px}
.gl{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
.n-pass .gd{background:var(--ok)}.n-pass .gl{color:var(--ok)}
.n-docs .gd,.n-fail .gd{background:var(--bad)}.n-docs .gl,.n-fail .gl{color:var(--bad)}
.n-env .gd{background:var(--warn-dot)}.n-env .gl{color:var(--warn)}
.n-block .gd{background:var(--panel);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--panel),inset 0 0 0 2px var(--warn-dot);color:var(--warn)}.n-block .gl{color:var(--warn)}
.n-none .gd,.n-skip .gd{background:var(--panel);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--panel),inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--faint);color:var(--mut)}.n-none .gl,.n-skip .gl{color:var(--mut)}
.n-root .gd{background:var(--acc)}.n-end .gd{background:var(--ok)}.n-end .gl{color:var(--ok)}
.n-end.bad .gd{background:var(--warn-dot)}.n-end.bad .gl{color:var(--warn)}
.br{list-style:none;padding:2px 0 10px 12px;margin:0 0 4px 12px;font-size:13px}
.br li{position:relative;padding:5px 0 5px 22px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:0 10px;align-items:baseline}
.br li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:1.5px;background:var(--line)}
.br li:last-child::before{bottom:50%}
.br li::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:50%;width:14px;height:1.5px;background:var(--line)}
.br .bk{color:var(--mut);font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
.br .bv{overflow-wrap:anywhere;min-width:0;color:var(--ink2)}
.br .bv.mono{font-size:12.5px}
.br .ok{color:var(--ok);font-weight:600}.br .bad{color:var(--bad);font-weight:600}
.gpan{position:sticky;top:130px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:18px;max-height:calc(100vh - 150px);overflow:auto;display:grid;gap:10px;align-content:start}
.gpan h3{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.gpan .pk{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut);margin-top:8px}
.gpan .mut{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px}
.gpan ol{padding-left:20px;font-size:14px}
.gpan ol li{margin-top:4px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.gpan .ok{color:var(--ok);font-weight:600}.gpan .bad{color:var(--bad);font-weight:600}
.evl{list-style:none;padding:0;font-size:14px;display:grid;gap:6px}
.evp{list-style:none;padding:18px 16px 18px 20px}
.evp>li{position:relative;padding:0 0 18px 34px}
.evp>li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:9px;top:0;bottom:0;width:1.5px;background:var(--line)}
.evp>li:first-child::before{top:10px}
.evp>li:last-child::before{bottom:auto;height:10px}
.evp>li:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
.evp .gd{left:0;top:2px;background:var(--acc)}
.evp .ek{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut)}
.evp .ev{font-size:14.5px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.evp .es{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:2px}
.lg2{display:inline-block;margin-left:6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:0 7px;vertical-align:1px}

/* bisect */
.tl{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:26px 20px 18px;overflow-x:auto}
.tlr{display:flex;position:relative;min-width:max-content}
.tlr::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:36px;right:36px;top:31px;height:2px;background:var(--line)}
.rel{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:5px;min-width:96px;flex:1;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
.rel .tg{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--bad);min-height:15px;letter-spacing:.02em}
.rel i{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--faint);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--panel);position:relative}
.rel.p i{background:var(--ok)}.rel.f i{background:var(--bad)}
.rel.first i{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--panel),0 0 0 7px var(--bad-ln)}
.rel b{font:600 12.5px var(--mono);color:var(--ink)}
.rel.first b{color:var(--bad)}
.rel.anim{opacity:.25;transition:opacity .3s var(--ease)}
.rel.anim.on{opacity:1}
.nt-row{margin-top:16px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.nt-row i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line);display:inline-block}
.tblw{overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13.5px}
.tbl th{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut);text-align:left;padding:9px 14px;background:var(--sunk);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap}
.tbl td{padding:10px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line2);vertical-align:top;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.tbl tr:first-child td{border-top:0}
.tbl td.mono{font-size:12.5px}
.tbl .res{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap}
.tbl tr.first td{background:var(--bad-bg)}
.call{margin-top:14px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--sunk);border:1px solid var(--line2);font-size:14.5px}
.call b{font-weight:600}
.call small{display:block;color:var(--mut);font-size:13px;margin-top:3px}
.mt16{margin-top:16px}
.mt12{margin-top:12px}

/* prereqs */
.pq-st{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;margin-top:14px;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:500}
.pq-st small{display:block;color:var(--mut);font-weight:400;font-size:13px;margin-top:2px}

/* footer */
.foot{border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:8px;background:var(--panel)}
.foot-in{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:28px 20px 36px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:20px 40px;align-items:end}
.foot h2{font-size:15px;font-weight:600}
.foot p{color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px;margin-top:2px}
.cmdbox{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:12px;max-width:620px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--sunk);padding:6px 6px 6px 14px}
.cmdbox code{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow-x:auto;white-space:nowrap;font-size:13.5px;padding:4px 0}
.cmdbox .p{color:var(--faint)}
.foot nav{display:flex;gap:18px;font-size:13.5px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.foot nav a{color:var(--mut);text-decoration:none}
.foot nav a:hover{color:var(--ink)}

/* pager */
.pager{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-top:32px;padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.pager .pd{display:flex;gap:6px}
.pager .pd button{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;border:0;padding:0;background:var(--line);cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,width .2s var(--ease)}
.pager .pd button[aria-current=step]{background:var(--ink);width:20px;border-radius:4px}
.pager .pv,.pager .nx{min-width:0}
.pager .b span.lb{max-width:24ch;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.report .pager{display:none}

/* keyboard help */
.keys{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:8px 14px;padding:8px 10px 10px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink2);align-items:center}
.keys>span{display:flex;gap:4px}

@media (max-width:1100px){.gwrap{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.gpan{position:static;max-height:none}}
@media (max-width:1000px){
.shell{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px;padding-top:0}
.rail{position:sticky;top:98px;z-index:20;background:var(--bg);margin:0 -20px;padding:8px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.rail h2,.rail .meter{display:none}
.rail ol{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none}
.rail ol::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.rail li+li::before{display:none}
.rb{grid-template-columns:auto auto;white-space:nowrap;padding:6px 10px;gap:0 7px}
.rb .rs{display:none}
.rb svg.i{width:16px;height:16px;background:none}
.stg{scroll-margin-top:160px}
html{scroll-padding-top:170px}
.fx-g{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.facts{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
.facts>div:nth-child(odd){border-left:0}
.facts>div:nth-child(n+3){border-top:1px solid var(--line2)}
.gpan{top:170px}
}
@media (max-width:640px){
.top-in{padding:0 12px;gap:6px}
.crumbs .sl,.crumbs .now,.crumbs a{display:none}
.top .hide-s{display:none}
.wrap{padding:0 16px}
.rail{margin:0 -16px;padding:8px 16px}
.rh h1{font-size:23px}
.rh-acts{width:100%}
.tabs .hint{display:none}
.st-h{grid-template-columns:12px 18px minmax(0,1fr);padding:10px 12px;gap:8px}
.st-h .sn{display:none}
.st-h .mt{grid-column:3;justify-self:start}
.st-b{padding:2px 12px 14px}
.kv{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
.kv>div{border-left:0!important;border-top:1px solid var(--line2)}
.kv>div:nth-child(-n+2){border-top:0}
.kv>div:nth-child(even){border-left:1px solid var(--line2)!important}
.verdict{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:18px}
.verdict .vi{grid-row:auto}
.foot-in{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:24px 16px 32px}
.pager .b span.lb{max-width:11ch}
.intro{padding:36px 16px 48px}
.intro h1{font-size:27px}
.gal button{grid-template-columns:18px minmax(0,1fr)}
.gal .gm{grid-column:2}
.dl{grid-template-columns:34px 34px 18px minmax(0,1fr)}
.ln{grid-template-columns:36px minmax(0,1fr)}
.cmdbox{flex-wrap:wrap}
.gb{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
.gr{grid-column:1;grid-row:auto;flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start}
.br{margin-left:4px;padding-left:6px}.br li{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);padding-left:18px}.br li::after{top:14px;width:10px}
.graph{padding:12px 8px 12px 12px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}}
</style>
