input.description: Demo video inspiration sheet
input.prompt:
Prepare a demo-video inspiration and shot sheet for FirstRun, Atharva Shah's neatHack 2026 hackathon project. Do NOT create any video, do not render anything, do not commit or push. Another Claude session may be editing the vault, so only create your one new file.

## Goal
A spectacular, "million-dollar" product demo under 2 minutes that combines three footage types: (1) human footage Atharva shoots on a DJI Action 4 camera, (2) screen recordings, (3) demo/motion elements. The app may change a lot by tomorrow, so the sheet must be modular: shots grouped by story beat, each marked "stable" (won't change) or "re-shoot if UI changes".

## Read first
- Atharva's global writing rules apply to all prose: no em/en dashes, no semicolons, sentences of 20 words or fewer, active voice, commands for actions, numbered lists only for sequences.
- D:\Atharva\NOTES\CLAUDE.md for where a file like this belongs in the vault and its frontmatter conventions. If a video/demo folder exists in NOTES, use it. Otherwise save to D:\Atharva\NOTES\ in the folder the vault rules suggest for project planning.
- The skills C:\Users\AtharvaShah\.claude\skills\video-make\SKILL.md, C:\Users\AtharvaShah\.claude\skills\video-edit\SKILL.md and C:\Users\AtharvaShah\.claude\skills\product-launch-video (if present) for what the toolchain can do later (HyperFrames motion graphics, captions, cuts), so the plan matches real capabilities. Read only.
- Product facts (read, do not invent): D:\Atharva\firstrun\README.md, D:\Atharva\firstrun\hackathon.md (build log), D:\Atharva\firstrun\docs\index.html (landing page copy and its 44-second launch film at docs/assets/firstrun-launch.mp4), and the worktree D:\Atharva\firstrun-run\docs\run.html (the new /run replay page: GitHub-Actions-style run view, walkthrough stages Read, Plan, Run, Fix, Prove, Docs graph, When did it break?, What the docs assume, Pull request; share popover; downloads; ?s=10#ex=dbt deep link to the dbt step 10 failure). Live: https://firstrun.atharvashah.com/ and https://firstrun.atharvashah.com/run.html#ex=dbt
- Core story facts: FirstRun runs a docs quickstart in a clean container, finds the first step that breaks, fixes it, and proves the fix with a second clean run. Real wins: dbt guide `jafgen --years 6` broke in jafgen 0.4.6 (2024-04-07), fix proven 9/9 in a fresh container, upstream PRs dbt-labs/docs.getdbt.com#10149 and #10150, entireio/cli#2724. Sponsor tools: neatlogs (tracing), Entire (session capture), cfo.ai (business plan), Jev/TypeSafe (classifier), Firecrawl, Claude Agent SDK.

## Sheet contents
1. One-line hook and the 2-minute story spine as timed beats (for example 0:00 to 0:08 cold open...). Total under 2:00.
2. B-roll list for the DJI Action 4: each shot with framing, mount/angle (chest mount, desk clamp, low-angle, POV over shoulder, timelapse), lens mode, frame rate (e.g. 4K 60 or 120 for slow-mo), lighting note, duration, and which beat it serves. Include human moments (frustration at broken docs, the "it passed" reaction, typing, coffee/night timelapse, phone notification of the PR).
3. Screen captures list: exact URL or command, viewport size (1920x1080 and a 1080x1920 vertical variant), what to click, cursor guidance, zoom/crop target, and stable vs re-shoot flag. Cover terminal `firstrun <url>` run, the /run walkthrough stages, the share popover, the GitHub PR pages, neatlogs trace, Entire session, the landing page.
4. Other visual elements: motion-graphic title cards, kinetic text callouts, number reveals (9/9, 10m to first success, $0.03), diff animations, logo lockups for sponsors, captions style, music mood and BPM, sound design (keyboard, success chime), transitions, color/LUT notes matching the site's light Apple-style look.
5. Shot checklist table ready to tick off on shoot day, plus a gear and settings checklist for the DJI Action 4.
6. Three reference demos for inspiration (real, well-known product launch videos, e.g. Linear, Vercel, Arc, Apple) with one line each on what to borrow. Only cite ones you are confident exist.

Report back the absolute file path and a 5-line summary of the story spine.
